title: IndiaAI Mission budget allocation, 2026-27
summary: The Union Budget 2026-27 allocated ₹1,000 crore to the IndiaAI Mission under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, half the ₹2,000 crore budget estimate for 2025-26 and 25% above that year's revised estimate of ₹800 crore. PRS Legislative Research links the lower allocation to under-use of funds, noting that utilisation has been below 50% since the mission began. This is a yearly tranche of the five-year mission outlay of ₹10,371.92 crore.
purpose: Annual budget estimate for implementing the IndiaAI Mission in 2026-27.
